pages.title: Sunny Kicks Summer Football Camp — Sign Up
pages.html:
⚽ SUNNY KICKS CAMP
AboutDatesCostsRegisterFAQ

Sunny Kicks Summer Football Camp — Sign Up

Give your child a summer full of sunshine, soccer skills, and new friends. Our certified coaches lead fun, safe, and energetic sessions for kids ages 5–14 in Riverton, TX.

Register NowSee Pricing

Camp Highlights

Skill Building

Daily drills on dribbling, passing, and shooting led by licensed youth coaches, tailored to every skill level.

Teamwork & Fun

Small-sided games, team challenges, and prizes keep campers active, engaged, and smiling all week long.

Safety First

Certified first-aid staff on-site, shaded water stations, and a 1:8 coach-to-camper ratio for peace of mind.

Schedule & Dates

Choose from three one-week sessions this summer. Camp runs Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM, at Meadowbrook Sports Park.

Summer 2024 Sessions
SessionDatesAge Group
Week 1June 10–14Ages 5–8
Week 2June 24–28Ages 9–11
Week 3July 8–12Ages 12–14

Costs & What's Included

Single Week

$149

One full week of camp, daily drills, team jersey, and a camper photo.

Two Weeks

$279

Save $19 when you sign up for any two sessions. Includes jersey and photo.

All Three Weeks

$399

Best value! All three sessions, jersey, photo, and a Sunny Kicks water bottle.

Price includes snacks, water, insurance, and an end-of-week award ceremony for every camper. Sibling discount: $10 off per additional child.

What Parents Say

“My daughter came home every day talking about her new friends and the fun drills. The coaches were patient, encouraging, and genuinely cared about each kid's progress.”

— Maria Gonzalez, parent of Sofia, age 7

Register Your Camper

Fill out the form below to reserve a spot. We'll email a confirmation and a packing checklist within 24 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should my child bring each day?

Cleats or sneakers, shin guards, a labeled water bottle, sunscreen, and a hat. We provide the camp jersey on day one.

Is lunch provided?

Camp runs in the morning only (9 AM–1 PM), so lunch is not included, but we provide a mid-morning snack and plenty of water.

What happens if it rains?

Sessions move to our covered pavilion for indoor drills and games. Camp only cancels in case of severe weather, with a make-up day offered.

Can I get a refund if plans change?

Full refunds are available up to 14 days before your session starts. After that, we offer credit toward a future session.

Sunny Kicks Summer Football Camp

124 Meadowbrook Lane, Riverton, TX 75001 · (555) 019-2837 · info@sunnykickscamp.com

© 2024 Sunny Kicks Summer Football Camp. All rights reserved.
